mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_oss_object (id, bucket_name, region, object_key, object_version_id, etag, content_hash, size_bytes, mime_type, encryption_type, object_role) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{object.id}), #{object.bucketName}, #{object.region}, #{object.objectKey}, #{object.objectVersionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{object.etag, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{object.contentHash}, #{object.sizeBytes}, #{object.mimeType}, #{object.encryptionType}, #{object.objectRole})
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(id) AS id, bucket_name AS bucketName, region, object_key AS objectKey, object_version_id AS objectVersionId, etag, content_hash AS contentHash, size_bytes AS sizeBytes, mime_type AS mimeType, encryption_type AS encryptionType, object_role AS objectRole FROM edudoc_oss_object WHERE bucket_name = #{bucketName} AND object_key = #{objectKey} AND status = 'A'
